evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label and modifies the core logging subsystem in src/logging.cpp and string utilities in src/util/string.h.
rationale: Prevents log injection vulnerabilities where untrusted inputs can forge fake log lines in debug.log. As shown in the PR description, a restricted RPC user could pass newline-delimited strings to forge critical messages like 'ERROR: ConnectTip: ConnectBlock ... failed', misleading node operators or monitoring tools.
